intro: Over twelve articles published between April 14 and April 30, 2026, ZCyberNews covered botnet activity involving threat actors Dort, Mirai, and The Gentlemen. Key vulnerabilities included CVE-2025-29635 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2024-3721 (CVSS 6.3), and CVE-2023-33538. Affected sectors spanned telecommunications, technology, corporate, cybersecurity services, and finance, with regions including Brazil, Canada, the Czech Republic, Germany, and Global. The coverage comprised nine high-severity, two medium, and one critical incident.
